base_member_text: Cross-line: k4 @L1177 uses ustar_c which is only computed inside the preceding x-direction diffusion loop (L1127-1132); in the y-direction loop (L1163-1192) ustar_c is never recomputed for the current (I,J), so k4 combines ustar_c4 for (I,J-1) with a stale ustar_c from the last x-loop iteration
audit_member_text: Use of a stale or undefined shear velocity in y diffusion: ustar_c is assigned only inside the preceding x-face loop and only when MASK(I,J)>0 (L1123-L1158), but the separate y-face loop never recomputes it and combines that residual scalar with cell-specific ustar_c4 in k4 (L1163-L1177). Thus every y-face can use the last qualifying x-loop cell's value, or an undefined value if no qualifying x cell ran.

base_member_text: Deposition loop bounds Jbeg,Jend+1 / Ibeg,Iend+1 (L1356-1357) exceed the source-loop bounds Jbeg,Jend / Ibeg,Iend (L1244-1245)
audit_member_text: Tau_xy has no initialization after allocation (L867-L925) and is assigned only where MASK>0 and H>MinDepthPickup (L1244-L1256). The later deposition loop spans Ibeg:Iend+1 and Jbeg:Jend+1 and, for every MASK>0 cohesive cell, reads Tau_xy in Pd (L1355-L1364). Shallow wet cells and wet halo cells can therefore read Tau_xy before assignment; no Tau_xy halo exchange appears between these regions.

audit_member_text: Cohesive deposition probability is not bounded below: Pd becomes negative when Tau_xy exceeds Tau_crd_coh (L1363), and D is then assigned WS*CH*Pd without MAX(0,...) (L1364). Because the transport source is Pickup-D (L1208), negative deposition acts as an additional positive concentration source.
dispositions.rationale: Cohesive Pd=1-Tau_xy/MAX(SMALL,Tau_crd_coh)(L1363), Tau_xy>Tau_crd_coh 시 Pd<0, D=WS*CH*Pd 무클램프(L1364) → 음의 침적(허위 침식원). base 미검출.

audit_member_text: Avalanche transfers are stored with scalar assignment rather than accumulation: each steep cell writes both its own and one neighbor's Zb_avalanching entry (L1585-L1627). Later loop iterations can overwrite earlier incoming/outgoing transfers to the same cell before the one-shot bed update at L1633-L1634, making the result loop-order dependent and losing superposed transfers.
dispositions.rationale: Avalanche Zb_avalanching(I,J)=dh·이웃=-dh 스칼라 대입(L1593-1594, 유사 L1604/1615/1626), 누적(+=) 아님 → 다중이웃 아발란치가 서로 덮어씀, 질량 비보존. base 미검출.
